KEN.note: Only a promise to send an AI Bill to Parliament; no draft or rule stated.
Only a promise of an AI Bill within four months; no draft begun is stated.

facts.fact: Citizen Digital reports that ICT Cabinet Secretary William Kabogo launched the Kenya National AI Strategy (2025-2030) at KICC, Nairobi, and that implementation needs at least Ksh 152 billion by 2030.
